fib: ______ is considered to be a Macro method of social work practice (Fink 1978) or a macro level of social work, as it is used to address broader social issues affecting a large group of people.

Community organization is considered to be a Macro method of social work practice (Fink 1978) or a macro level of social work, as it is used to address broader social issues affecting a large group of people.
______ is one of the multiple levels of social intervention.
Community is one of the multiple levels of social intervention.
______ is the process of building constructive and sustainable social justice and societies founded on mutual respect.
Community development is the process of building constructive and sustainable social justice and societies founded on mutual respect.
______ is the basis for self-sufficiency and sustainable development.
Self-help is the basis for self-sufficiency and sustainable development.
______ is the generic concept used to describe the various types of group-level action which was used as a convenient umbrella word instead of the concept community organization.
Community engagement is the generic concept used to describe the various types of group-level action which was used as a convenient umbrella word instead of the concept community organization.
______ means building constructive and inclusive societies that concentrate on social justice and mutual respect.
Development of the Society means building constructive and inclusive societies that concentrate on social justice and mutual respect.
